title: The Spoiled Cat Christmas Setup
description: A spoiled cat Christmas setup from Walmart: a green Christmas tree cat tree, a pink ornament pet bed, a gingerbread house scratcher, a pink toy stocking, a holiday collar and bandana set and Santa and reindeer teaser wands.
intro: Every December the cat picks one spot to wreck, and it is always the real tree. Two ornaments on the floor before breakfast and a look that says she meant it. So I built the setup that gives her a tree of her own: a green one shaped like a Christmas tree with holes to nap in, a pink ornament bed at the bottom, a gingerbread house to shred instead of the couch, and a stocking stuffed with toys that will end up under the fridge by March. Peace on earth, or at least in the living room.

sections.heading: Her own Christmas tree
paragraphs: The Amolife 63 inch Christmas cat tree and tower condo in green, the Vibrant Life Holiday extra small ornament pet bed in pink, and the FurHaven gingerbread house corrugated cat scratcher with catnip.

sections.heading: The stocking stuffers
paragraphs: The Vibrant Life Holiday cat toys stocking in pink with 18 pieces, the Vibrant Life Holiday woodland floral cat collar and slider set, and the Vibrant Life Holiday Santa and reindeer teaser wand cat toys, 2 count.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The room, the cat and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
